newsitem.title: USA: Belco Oil drills higher producing lateral.
newsitem.headline: Belco Oil drills higher producing lateral.

text.p: Belco Oil & Gas Corp said Wednesday production from the Brown 1-H well, a single lateral horizontal well in Washington County, Texas, started on March 30 and is currently at a daily rate of 100.3 million cubic feet of natural gas from the Austin Chalk formation at a flowing tubing pressure of 5,025 pounds per square inch on a 48/inch choke.

Based on initial flow rates, this is believed to be the largest horizontal gas well ever drilled onshore in the United States, Belco said. The well was completed at a true vertical depth of 14,600 feet.
Belco has a 30 percent working interest in this well. Chesapeake Energy Corp is the operator and holds a 67 percent working interest.

Belco chief executive Robert A. Belfer said "The Brown 1-H well reaffirms our belief that the deeper Giddings area has the potential for producing some of the most productive wells drilled anywhere in the United States."
